THE BUSINESS GAP

Why do real estate teams lose customer context?

Buyers compare projects across time zones, languages and channels. Lead volume alone does not create effective follow-up; conversion quality depends on whether the team can understand and continue every important conversation.

01

Buyer needs are scattered across channels

Calls, WhatsApp, meetings and CRM notes remain disconnected, making full context difficult to recover.

02

Managers see activity, not conversation quality

Call counts and statuses do not show whether an advisor understood budget, decision roles, concerns and purchase timing.

03

Multilingual teams struggle to standardize service

English, Arabic and other languages coexist, while customer language and top-advisor methods remain difficult to retain.

FROM CONVERSATION TO ACTION

A customer intelligence workflow for property sales

Start with one team, one communication source and measurable follow-up goals. There is no requirement to replace the CRM first.

01

Capture approved conversations

Connect selected calls, meetings or private channels with clear local legal, company policy and customer notice requirements.

02

Build the property buyer profile

Identify budget, use case, investment or end-user intent, location, unit type, payment plan, decision roles, concerns and timing.

03

Help advisors follow up

Produce summaries, actions, unanswered questions and next-step guidance to reduce handoff gaps and repeated questions.

04

Show managers the patterns

Surface recurring project feedback, loss reasons, coaching priorities and market questions across conversations.

FAQ

Dubai real estate sales AI FAQ

Is TellWin a real estate CRM?＋

No. TellWin focuses on conversation understanding and sales intelligence, complementing the CRM by returning richer customer context to existing records.

Does it support English and Arabic?＋

The product direction covers multilingual conversations, but each language, accent and property vocabulary must be evaluated with representative pilot samples.

Can it automatically message buyers?＋

The default approach produces summaries, actions and suggestions for advisor review. Automation depends on channel capability, business rules and compliance boundaries.

How would a Dubai pilot start?＋

Choose one sales team, buyer segment and communication source; define data and compliance boundaries; then evaluate accuracy and adoption using real follow-up work.

This page describes the target workflow and implementation approach. It does not claim standardized integration across every language, channel or local system. Final scope depends on pilot evaluation and compliance review.
